record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: on-move passive (PassiveEffects entry with an OnChangePositionEffect): cosmetic disguise via the index field
record.summary: When a unit with this passive is moved to a new position during a pick phase (or is swapped by another unit being dragged onto it), the effect looks at the same player's board for a unit standing directly to the left of the new position (x-1, same y). If one is found, the Zorua/Zoroark's index is set to that neighbour's index. Name, stats, types and skill are not changed by the passive. The skill (NIGHT_DAZE for Zorua / Zoroark, BITTER_MALICE for the Hisuian forms) resets the unit's index to PkmIndex[name], which the source comments call breaking the disguise. If no unit is on the left, the index is left as it was (it is not reset to the unit's own).
triggers: onPokemonChangePosition after a manual move or swap in the pick phase

effects.scaling: none (no AP, no crit, no numeric value)
effects.resolution: assignment of the string field index; no stat helper, damage or status is involved

effects.declaredRaw: NIGHT_DAZE / BITTER_MALICE cast sets index := PkmIndex[name]
effects.resolution: performed by the skills, not by the passive; listed to show how the disguise ends

effects.declaredRaw: other code reads a unit's index to choose a class
effects.resolution: example only; the set of readers was not enumerated

conditions: Only pick-phase moves trigger it (OnChangePositionEffect contract); nothing in the passive runs during a fight.
The lookup uses the new position's left neighbour at the moment of the move; a neighbour that later moves or changes index does not update the copy.
Only the passive's holder is changed, and only its index; the neighbour is unaffected.
The ally search uses the whole player.board (the same collection used for bench and board units), so a neighbour is matched by coordinates only.
record.resetBehaviour: No stored counter. The index stays copied until the next move re-evaluates it, or until the unit casts its skill (index reset to its own).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: No combat behaviour in the passive itself; the skills NIGHT_DAZE and BITTER_MALICE are separate records and their disguise-dependent effects (they read whether the unit was disguised) are not covered here
Which other code reads Pokemon.index in fights (StoredPower, SpectralThief and others use a target's index): the full set of readers was not enumerated
unresolved: Whether pokemon.index of a disguised unit propagates into a fight entity (PokemonEntity copy of index) and what that changes for the opponent was not read
Whether bench positions (y = 0) are matched by the neighbour lookup in the same way as board rows was not examined beyond the coordinate comparison
Whether the unit is restored to its own index when it is moved to a place with no left neighbour: the effect does nothing in that case (source shows no else branch)
Whether the evolved unit (Zorua->Zoroark) keeps or resets the copied index was not read
Client-side use of index for sprites was not read
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
